content: Ɓi rimkoh ŋ Esaaw
Inii weɗ naandsuku ŋ Esaaw, yi teeku Edom, na ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe.
Esaaw ɓayeen ɓitiɓ ŋ cafaƴ caŋ Kanaan ; ɓeem ɓa nikee Aada na Ohlibaama. Aada nikee kuɓu Eloon ya ɓaahee ŋ cuuɓiŋ Hit ci. Ohlibaama nikee kuɓu Aana, Aana nikka kuɓu Sibeyon ya ɓaahee ŋ cuuɓiŋ Hiw ci.
Taambɗoh Nebayot, Baasmat yi kuɓu Ismaayla namee ɓaah ŋ ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɗe.
Aada a yi rim Elifaas, Baasmat rimmba Rewyel,
Ohlibaama rimmba Yewus na Yalaam na Koorah. Ɓii ɓeɗ kuɓuuci ƴaar ci Esaaw raakoh Kanaan.
Wa raakka mbeh, Esaaw ɓayya ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɗe na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ, na ɓooɓaŋ ɗe, a ɓayndohha ɗoopaat caŋ ɗe na in ca a raakoh Kanaan jen, a yongsukka kur wiiriis, a ussa taambɗoh ce Yaŋhooɓa.
Raak-raakaŋ ɓa laayee laay po ɓa haɓisseeɗi ŋ kur ka sagu ɗoopaat caŋ ɓa.
Esaaw yi teeku Edom, kaɗoh yipa ɗaa ŋ tangoocaŋ Seyiir.
Inii weɗ naandsuku ŋ Esaaw na ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe. A yi caaciŋ Edom ca genee ŋ tangoocaŋ Seyiir.
Tiik ciŋ kuɓuuciŋ Esaaw ƴaar ci ceɗi cii : Elifaas yi a raak na ɓitiice Aada, na Rewyel yi a raak na Baasmat.
Kuɓuuciŋ Elifaas ƴaar ci nikka Teemaan, Omaar, Sefoo, Gataam na Kenas.
Elifaas raakeen ɓitiɓ ñaam na woyse Timna ; a raakeen na ɗe kuɓu teeku Amalek. Ɓeem ɓeɗ set ciŋ Aada, ɓiti Esaaw.
Kuɓuuciŋ Rewyel ƴaar ci nikee Nahat, Seerah, Samaa na Misaa. Ɓeem ɓeɗ set ciŋ Baasmat, ɓiti Esaaw.
Kuɓuuci ƴaar ciŋ ɓiti Esaaw yi na woyse Ohlibaama, kuɓkiŋ Aana yiŋ Sibeyon, ɓeɗ Yewus, Yalaam na Koorah.
Kilifaaciŋ ɓi rimkoh ŋ Esaaw ɓa ɗi ɓii : Ɓi rimkoh ŋ saawiŋ ɗe Elifaas nikee Teemaan, Omaar, Sefoo, Kenas,
Koorah, Gataam na Amalek ; ɓeem ɓeɗ nikee kilifa ŋ kur kaŋ Edom ɓi rimkoh ŋ Elifaas kuɓkiŋ Aada.
Ɓi rimkoh ŋ Rewyel, kuɓu Esaaw, nikee Nahat, Seerah, Samaa na Misaa ; ɓeem ɓeɗ nikee kilifa ŋ kur kaŋ Edom ɓi rimkoh ŋ Rewyel kuɓu Baasmat, ɓiti Esaaw.
Ɓi rimkoh ŋ Ohlibaama nikee Yewus, Yalaam na Koorah ; ɓeem ɓeɗ kilifaaca rimkoh ŋ kuɓkiŋ Aana, Ohlibaama yi ɓiti Esaaw.
Ɓeem ɓeɗ rimkoh ŋ Esaaw, ɓa nikka kilifa ŋ Edom.
Ɓi rimkoh ŋ Seyiir

Ɓii ɓeɗ rimkoh ŋ Seyiir yi ɓaah ŋ cuuɓaŋ Hoor ca te ɓi Edom raakka ɓa geniɗ nga : Lootaan, Sobaal, Sibeyon, Aana, Disoon, Eeser na Disaan. Ɓeem ɓeɗ nikee ɓi rimkoh ŋ Seyiir, kilifaacaŋ cuuɓaŋ Hoor ca genee ngaŋ kur kaŋ Edom.
Kuɓuuciŋ Lootaan ƴaar ci nikka Hoori na Hemaam ; taambɗoh ce ɓitiɓ teeksee Timna.
Kuɓuuciŋ Sobaal ƴaar ci nikka Alwaan, Manahat, Eebal, Sefoo na Onaam.
Kuɓuuciŋ Sibeyon ƴaar ci nikee Ayaa na Aana. Aana yeem a yi koc hot masma dohɗa balɗee ŋ kehƴi ngaŋ bilaf fa, waam raak ɗe niiɗee mbaam caŋ baab ɓa Sibeyon.
Kuɓuuciŋ Aana nikee Disoon na taambɗoh ce ɓitiɓ Ohlibaama.
Kuɓuuci ƴaar ciŋ Disoon nikee Hemdaan, Esbaan, Yitraan na Keraan.
Kuɓuuci ƴaar ciŋ Eeser nikka Bilhaan, Sawaan na Akaan.
Ɓiŋ Disaan nikka Uus na Araan.
Kon, ɓii ɓeɗ nikee kilifaacaŋ cuuɓaŋ Hoor ca ŋ kur kaŋ Seyiir : Lootaan, Sobaal, Sibeyon, Aana, Disoon, Eeser na Disaan.
Buur ca nikee ŋ Edom
Bala buur raakan ŋ Israayel ɗah, ɓii ɓeɗ nikee buur caŋ kur kaŋ Edom :
Bela kuɓu Beyoor, a yi nikee ŋ Dinaaba.
Wa Bela kaan, Yoobaab kuɓu Seerah, ya nikee ŋ Bosra a yi namsiɗ ɗe.
Wa Yoobaab kaan, Husaam ya ŋ kur kaŋ Teemaan-Teemaan ca, a yi namsiɗ ɗe.
Wa Husaam kaan, Hadad, ya nikee ŋ Awit, kuɓu Bedad, namsiɗta ɗe ; a yi laɓee Majaan-Majaan ca ŋ kur kaŋ Mowab.
Wa Hadad kaan, Samla ya ŋ Masreeka namsiɗta ɗe.
Wa Samla kaan, Sawul ya ŋ Rehobot-Hanahar namsiɗta ɗe.
Wa Sawul kaan, Ba'al-Hanan kuɓkiŋ Akboor namsiɗta ɗe.
Wa Ba'al-Hanan kuɓkiŋ Akboor kaan, Hadar ya ŋ Pawu namsiɗta ɗe. Ɓitiice teeksee Mehtabeel kuɓu Matareed yi kuɓkiŋ Mesaahab.
Ɓii ɓeɗ nikee kilifaacaŋ cuuɓiŋ Edom ci puloh ŋ Esaaw, yaa nu nga ɗah, na kur kaŋ ɗa : Timna, Alwaah, Yetet, Ohlibaama, Eela, Pinoon, Kenas, Teemaan, Mibsaar, Magdiyel na Iraam.
